title: Roku Q3: revenue up 24% YoY to $1.5B, Platform revenue up 23% YoY to $1.3B, ad revenue up 23% YoY to $727.4M, and subscriptions revenue up 23% YoY to $580.9M (Todd Spangler/Variety)
summary: Todd Spangler / Variety: Roku Q3: revenue up 24% YoY to $1.5B, Platform revenue up 23% YoY to $1.3B, ad revenue up 23% YoY to $727.4M, and subscriptions revenue up 23% YoY to $580.9M — For the third quarter, Roku handily topped Wall Street earnings expectations, with top-line growth of 24% to $1.50 billion in revenue.
